description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open source project and is responsible for displaying the issue tracker view page. It initializes page settings, manages issue tracker items, checks user permissions, and renders the output using Smarty templates.

classes.name: tlIssueTracker
classes.description: A class managing issue tracker operations such as retrieving issue trackers and checking their connection status.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns an object containing request parameters and user context information.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the user has rights to view or manage issue trackers.
